description: Defines the MoneyTransaction class, including properties, copy method, and color getter, as well as the TxType enum for transaction types.

classes.name: MoneyTransaction
classes.description: Represents a financial transaction with properties such as id, amount, type, category, date, note, and a color getter based on transaction type.

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Returns a copy of the MoneyTransaction with optional new values for its properties.

methods.name: color
methods.description: A getter that returns a color representing the transaction type: green for income, red for expense.
